geography.name: Brunete · illustrated district scenario
geography.attribution: AI-assisted illustration adapted from the approved concept using PNOA imagery as a reference. Original reference: PNOA máxima actualidad · CC BY 4.0 scne.es; illustration, crop and schematic overlays modified.
geography.notes: Illustrated demo geography, not georeferenced aerial imagery. Four neighbourhood-inspired response areas follow the illustrated housing clusters and streets; actual neighbourhood positions and boundaries are not reproduced. Names refer to Brunete areas but population allocations and placements are schematic. Distance scale is a simulation convention. Farm occupancy is assumed.

population_source.allocation: Scenario allocation of the municipal total across Casco Histórico 3942 (35%), Prado Alto 2815 (25%), Prado Nuevo 3378 (30%), Valle de los Rosales 1126 (10%). Counts and illustrated footprints are estimated demo allocations, not measured neighbourhood census data or official boundaries. Farm occupancy is additional and assumed.

farm_occupancy.basis: Assumed demo occupancy of visitors and staff; not verified resident population or published capacity.
